question: How many correct usable deliveries do RepoForge and an installed Codex local-provider configuration produce on the same newly selected task, with no outside solver technical hint or patch?
comparison_type: whole product configurations, not isolated architecture, context, model-quality or experience contribution
model_content: qwen3-coder:30b digest06c1097efce0431c2045fe7b2e5108366e43bee1b4603a7aded8f21689e90bca for both if still verified at freeze

known_configuration_difference.RepoForge: explicit num_ctx65536, output4096, seed0 and temperature0 in prior native wire
known_configuration_difference.Codex_local: probe observed loaded context4096 and fallback model metadata; sampling/output request settings not independently captured
known_configuration_difference.interpretation: same weights are not identical inference configurations. Before either task arm starts, freeze actual settings and disclose unresolved differences; no isolated mechanism claim from this pilot.

common_conditions_to_freeze.source: same pinned source plus documented common public/environment fixtures, fresh independent workspace for each arm
common_conditions_to_freeze.requirement_and_feedback: same public requirement and public acceptance; no reference patch or hidden labels in either solver
common_conditions_to_freeze.authority: same declared source-write and build scope; private evidence and tests protected; actual tool/sandbox differences and any unauthorized action separately reported
common_conditions_to_freeze.resource: one owned1800-second task window per product, cumulative meter_only; shared hardware/server serialized, no overlapping inference
common_conditions_to_freeze.delivery: final source plus usable corresponding build artifacts; exact source/artifact identity, independent acceptance and actual delivery all required
common_conditions_to_freeze.learning: no injected strategy or hidden/task-specific memory; auxiliary extraction not a prerequisite for task completion. Exact switches frozen before task runs; this pilot does not measure experience benefit.
common_conditions_to_freeze.why: 为什么要有它：先固定共同条件与真实配置差异再运行两组，避免事后补对照，也不让长期学习研究挡住产品任务。

five_data.correct_delivery: all registered tasks retained per product; no-hint/no-patch distinct from hint-only and rescue
five_data.human_and_waiting: actual timing/declaration only; unknown human active time retained; all-task limited success and quality-matched waiting reported separately
five_data.cost: all task failures/retries/recovery/auxiliary use, qualification/evaluation and platform development separately; zero success has no finite unit cost
five_data.counterexample_repair: actual delivered diagnostic feedback plus ability/resources to continue define K; repeated/no-code attempts remain; compile and behavior split
five_data.judgment_or_experience: 本批未覆盖独立机制贡献；不用离线/探针/历史结果替代任务收益

readiness_return: Only task-source, common public reproduction and independent acceptance qualification remain before freezing run inputs. Direct defects may be fixed from originals, not by starting a new provider, training, memory or evidence platform.
limited_claim: one-task development pilot; repository is exposed, no U5 transfer or general product advantage. Closed1552 B is historical0/1, never retroactively one arm of this pair.
why: 为什么要有它：失败之后转向可回答产品价值的问题，仍保留内部改进和U1-U5责任，而不是继续同题求成功或把小试点当整体完成。
